# Autonomic AI
> Local-first deterministic verification engine and execution governor for autonomous coding agents.

## Core Products
- **Tekmor**: Local-first proof evaluation engine and process stop gate for coding agents. Binds test execution to cryptographic git tree SHAs. Emits tamper-proof receipts to `.verify/receipt.json`. Enforces hard process boundaries via Claude Code stop hooks with 0 model calls.
- **Thesmos (agent-spine)**: Deterministic Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) execution engine for multi-step agent workflows. Replaces unbounded prompt loops with validated YAML specifications, immutable append-only SQLite snapshots, human approval gates, and zero-token time-travel replay.

## CLI Commands
- `brew tap autonomic-ai-dev/tap`
- `brew install autonomic-ai-dev/tap/tekmor`
- `brew install autonomic-ai-dev/tap/agent-spine`
- `tekmor verify -- <command>`: Runs allowlisted check in subshell, writes `.verify/receipt.json`.
- `tekmor verify receipt`: Validates status and freshness against current git tree.
- `agent-spine run <workflow.yaml>`: Executes deterministic DAG workflow.
- `agent-spine replay <execution_id>`: Reconstructs state from SQLite with 0 LLM tokens re-spent.
